title: cgroup-resource-controls
summary: Diagnose and configure cgroup v2 resource controls for serving/training workloads: distinguish quota stalls from sibling contention (cpu.max vs cpu.weight, cpu.stat vs cpu.stat.local), audit requested-versus-effective cpuset with migration-cost budgeting, triage memory pressure with PSI plus event deltas (high/max/low semantics), and gate io.max caps on confirmed block-backed traffic. Includes hierarchy/delegation/permission preflight and a rollback contract. Extra resource allocation is treated as a capacity spend, never as an efficiency improvement. Control-plane procedures only — applying settings requires separate authorization.
